calendarFaqs.q: When does Chandler Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Chandler Unified School District starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, July 15, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the three CUSD intersessions in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: CUSD lists three intersessions: September 21–October 2, 2026; December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027; and March 8–19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after each intersession?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return October 6 after fall intersession, January 5 after winter intersession, and March 23 after spring intersession because CUSD schedules teacher workdays immediately after each intersession.

calendarFaqs.q: Which early-dismissal dates apply to my student’s school?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary conference early dismissals are August 19–20 and February 17–18. Junior high early dismissals are split by school abbreviation: AJHS/BJHS/CCJHS/SJHS use August 25 and February 2, while ACPMS/PJHS/WJHS use August 27 and February 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CUSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school and high school graduation date is Thursday, May 20, 2027, with a half-day schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded CUSD calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later CUSD revisions.

customSections.label: How the CUSD Calendar Works
customSections.content: CUSD follows a modified year-round calendar. Students have two-week intersessions in the fall, winter, and spring, while the district retains a longer summer break. For families new to Chandler Unified, the biggest differences are the mid-July start and the Monday teacher workday after each intersession.

groups.label: Planning Around the CUSD Calendar
items: The three intersessions are the longest breaks available for travel and child care planning during the school year.
Each intersession is followed by a Monday teacher workday, so students return on Tuesday.
Some early dismissals apply only to elementary conference dates or specific junior high school groups.

customSections.label: Early Dismissals and Return Dates
customSections.content: Use the return dates below when planning around intersessions, and check which early-dismissal group applies to your student’s school.

rows: September 21–October 2, 2026. October 5 is a teacher workday, so students return October 6, 2026.
December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday, so students return January 5, 2027.
March 8–19, 2027. March 22 is a teacher workday, so students return March 23, 2027.
Early dismissal applies August 19–20, 2026, and February 17–18, 2027. Check your school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.
CUSD separates junior high schools into two early-dismissal groups. Match the abbreviation in the official calendar to your student’s school before planning transportation.
Junior high and high school students have early dismissals December 16–17 and May 19. May 20 follows a half-day schedule and is also the scheduled high school graduation date.

customSections.label: Quarters, Semesters, and Early Dismissals
customSections.content: CUSD divides the year into four quarters. The end of each semester also includes early-dismissal dates for junior high and high school students.

rows: The first quarter ends September 18, 2026, after 47 days.
The second quarter ends December 17, 2026, completing a 49-day quarter and a 96-day first semester.
The third quarter ends March 5, 2027, after 42 days.
The fourth quarter ends May 20, 2027, completing a 42-day quarter and an 84-day second semester.
